skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the principles of computer architecture, including instruction set architecture, pipeline techniques, and memory hierarchy.
Apply quantitative methods to measure and analyze the performance of computer systems.
Develop the ability to solve complex problems related to computer architecture independently and collaboratively.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems and complete tasks related to computer architecture.
Evaluate and analyze different computer architecture designs and their performance.
Conduct research and gather information on computer architecture topics.
Effectively present research findings and solutions to problems related to computer architecture.
